Task: Find the correlation with US Karen data and the other three countries in the future 40 years. (assume only female Karens)

```{r}
library(dplyr)

source("karen-helper-fns.R")
```



```{r}
helperCorLagKaren <- function(name_data, lagN, karen_data) {
  tryCatch(cor(name_data$prop, lag(karen_data$prop, lagN), method = "kendall", use = "complete.obs"), error = function(i) {
    return(NA)
  })
}


helperCorLagKaren(full_names_data_nice, 40, karen_data)

US karen females, compare at each country Karen females (one at a time)

```


```{r}
data_US <- full_names_data_nice %>%
  filter(country == "United States", name == "Karen", sex == "Girl")

data_US


data_england <- full_names_data_nice %>%
  filter(country == "England/Wales", name == "Karen", sex == "Girl")

data_england


data_scotland <- full_names_data_nice %>%
  filter(country == "Scotland", name == "Karen", sex == "Girl")

data_scotland


data_northern_ireland <- full_names_data_nice %>%
  filter(country == "Northern Ireland", name == "Karen", sex == "Girl")

data_northern_ireland
```

```{r}
helperCorLagKaren(data_US, 40, data_england)

helperCorLagKaren(data_US, 40, data_scotland)

helperCorLagKaren(data_US, 40, data_northern_ireland)
```
